svg.text: Multiblock form of the Repair Bench: a row of portal-frame repair bays. No recipe map; repair cost is read from item NBT.
lit = hatch tiers, white outline = controller tier
LAYERS (each grid is one layer from above; rows run front to back)
Footprint: 7 wide x 7 tall x (3 + 2n) long
Layers: 7 tall (y0 to y6); head 2 long, bay 2
Blocks: head B 14, L 20, G 10, R 19, H 1; bay
Controller: in the front wall of the head
Maintenance (1): on R in the head and tail
No Muffler and no pollution: repairing makes
Add repair bays: n = 2 to 8, each 2 blocks
long (+2 length), one cradle and one hoist per
Hologram stack size selects n. Default 4 bays;
8 bays clear a locker in one cycle.
Parallels = n bays: each repairs one item per
cycle, scanned from the Input Bus in order.
Tier gate: the lowest Energy Hatch tier is the
highest item tier it repairs; a LuV or ZPM
item needs a LuV or ZPM hatch.
Cycle = 2 s + 8 s x largest damage fraction;
Each item is all-or-nothing against its repair
list. Output keeps every NBT key (enchants,
camo, IC2 charge); GT tools are never touched.
Source: docs/gregguns-spec/08-machines-production/multiblocks.md and machine-roster.md. Layouts are designs, not Java; figures marked proposal are not settled.
